overall_design: We then performed gene expression profiling using RNA-seq data from 2 different cells treated with the same concentration of FFAs.Comparative gene expression profiling analysis of RNA-seq data for L02 cells (LY6D-OE) treated with FFAs.
summary: To investigate the regulatory function of LY6D in NAFLD, we established a LY6D-overexpressing L02 cell line treated with FFAs.
title: Effect of overexpression of LY6D on gene expression in L02 hepatocytes
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
